source.title: VASCULAR COMPLICATIONS IN PEDIATRIC PANCREATITIS: A CASE SERIES

consistency_findings: The abstract reports 5/410 (1.2%) peripancreatic vascular complications, comprising 4 venous thromboses and 1 left gastric artery pseudoaneurysm. The What is New box calls 1.2% the incidence of PSMVT; strictly, 4/410 venous thromboses is approximately 1.0%, so the source uses vascular-complication and PSMVT terminology inconsistently.

The abstract states that among 2 venous-thrombosis patients who did not receive anticoagulants, 1 recanalized. The Results text instead says 1 of the other 3 non-anticoagulated patients recanalized, apparently including the pseudoaneurysm patient; Table 2 labels that patient as did not re-canalize despite treatment by arterial coiling. These source-specific semantics are preserved rather than silently harmonized.
extraction_limitations: The referenced supplementary material/Table S1 was not present in the retrieved Google Drive folder and was not reconstructed from outside sources.
The study is descriptive and contains only five vascular-complication cases; treatment and safety statements therefore have very small denominators.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human source-verification step occurred.
protocol_source_note: The governing file is named summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md but its internal heading identifies Integrated Compact v3. Per project precedence, the supplied v4-named file was used as governing SEA source and the label mismatch is reported rather than corrected.
writing_skill_note: The requested unslop.skill.md was searched in the available File Library and Google Drive GitHub Sync/SKILLS area but no source file was available; no undocumented rules were inferred from prior reports mentioning it.
